description: The main window. Least privilege (AGENTS.md): the app's own commands and nothing else. The job commands (D0), the browsing commands (D1), the staging commands (D2), the extract plan command (D3), and the foreign-archive commands (D8: open, close, list, plan an extract; the archive and the folder come from native dialogs shown by Rust, a password is sent once in the open call and kept only in Rust). The native dialogs (open, choose sources, save, choose an extract folder) are shown from Rust and dropped paths are received by Rust, so the webview never names a path: no fs, shell, http, or dialog permission is granted, and core:default is not granted.
